blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—With the playoff race heating up in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament, St. Benilde turned John Morales to beat Lyceum, 107-103, at San Andres Sports Complex on Friday. Morales finished with 18 points, five rebounds and a steal in a timely breakout performance to help the Blazers secure their second straight win. More importantly, the victory allowed Benilde to join Group A’s top-seed frenzy with Jose Rizal University and San Beda, with all three teams holding identical 8-3 records. “This is so important because the standings are so tight.
